summary: sextant-cli-darwin-arm64 ships a Mach-O backdoor with WebSocket C2, Anthropic credential harvest, and LAN-exposed listeners
details: The npm package ships a macOS arm64 Go binary at bin/sxt that implements a remote shell over WebSocket. The binary is linked against github.com/creack/pty (pseudoterminal) and github.com/coder/websocket, and embeds the hardcoded C2 endpoint wss://relay.sextant.top plus an installer URL https://relay.sextant.top/install, giving a remote party at that host an interactive shell on the installer's Mac. The same binary embeds the regex sk-ant-[a-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,} and the string CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR alongside references to https://api.anthropic.com/v1/models and https://claude.ai/, targeting Anthropic API keys stored in Claude Code's config directory. It queries http://ip-api.com/json/ with a full field set (country, city, ISP, org, AS, proxy/hosting/mobile flags, source IP) to fingerprint the host's network location, and additionally binds listener sockets on 0.0.0.0:7280, 0.0.0.0:7281, and 0.0.0.0:9000, exposing services to all network interfaces rather than loopback. The binary also references https://claude.ai/install.sh together with sudo/curl and write paths under /usr/bin and ~/.bun/bin, indicating a fetch-and-execute path invoked during operation. The package.json declares its license via https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control, corroborating the observed behavior.
